items.title: Louis Gallaud Interview, 1960-03-18
items.q: Well, I used to have a violin player there, Willie Dan's boy. ... He used to come here.

ctx.x: I've heard of a Buddy Bertrand, uh, Jolly Roll, um,

Yeah, he was, he played piano too. He played piano too. He died some time ago. He used to be around 25 all the time. He used to play piano around there sometime. And when we used to get off, I used to go around there. Well, I used to have a violin player there, Willie Dan's boy. Oh, yeah. Playing violin from Baton Rouge. He's in Baton Rouge. He was sick some time ago. I tried to find him. But he used to come here. Well, he's in Baton Rouge. You think he's still up there then? Yeah, he's still living. He still was…
We were trying, we didn't never, didn't find anybody.
